topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: Finding Grandma's engagement ring in that pawn shop was a shock. I recognized it instantly, the unique design she always said meant the world to her. It felt like a punch in the gut, seeing it there, far from home. I should have known where it was, made sure it was safe. Rushing to buy it back, I couldn’t help but think of all the moments it should have been there—weddings, holidays, family gatherings. It’s a weight on my chest, knowing it was lost, and now reclaimed. I need to figure out how to return it to the family, do right by Grandma’s memory.
